title: Observation
description: One sighting of one shareable network, after the filter rules in privacy/filter-rules.md have been applied on the device.

ssid.description: Network name as broadcast. Hidden or empty SSIDs are dropped by R1.

bssid.description: Lowercase colon-separated MAC address (R9). Locally administered addresses are dropped by R3.

security.description: Phase 1 collects only networks that anyone may join (R5).

captive_portal.description: Set to detected only when the device actually met a portal.

lat.description: Device position, rounded to 4 decimal places (R10). Not expressed as multipleOf: binary floating point makes that unreliable. The server checks the rounding with a 1e-9 tolerance instead.

lon.description: Device position, rounded to 4 decimal places (R10). Not expressed as multipleOf: binary floating point makes that unreliable. The server checks the rounding with a 1e-9 tolerance instead.

accuracy_m.description: Reported accuracy of the device's own fix. Worse than 50 m is dropped by R6.

rssi.description: Signal strength in dBm, used to weight the position estimate.

frequency_mhz.description: Channel centre frequency, when the platform reports it.

source.description: connected means the device was joined to this network. iOS can only report connected.
